name: claudinho
description: Live football in Claude Code for the competition you follow: the score or the countdown above the prompt (the same line on demand with /claudinho), a toast that says what happened (a goal and its scorer, full time and the result), a goal celebration with the Claude mascot, the live score beside your prompt for the model, all from the installed claudinho CLI's local cache, and a match pane with the match you follow, its goals and cards (/claudinho match, read by the CLI). Live data: ESPN. Not affiliated with FIFA, any confederation, league or club, or Anthropic.

toasts.title: Score toasts
toasts.description: Which goals, score changes and full times raise a toast: pinned, your pinned team's match (claudinho follow <alias> --team <name>); with no pin saved, pinned toasts nothing. all, every live match of the competition you follow; off, none.

celebrate.title: Goal celebration
celebrate.description: On a goal for your team the toasts announce (or any goal under all of a match with no pinned side), and at full time on its win or draw, the band plays a short celebration; off plays nothing.

context.title: Prompt context
context.description: While a match is live, each prompt you send carries the live score for Claude to read; off sends nothing with your prompts.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the band, the toasts, the goal celebration and the match pane: en, es, pt or fr; auto follows CLAUDINHO_LANG, then LANG (es_MX.UTF-8 is es), else English. The terminal statusline and the live score for Claude stay English.
